newsitem.title: USA: Foundation Health eyes Physicians Health bid.
newsitem.headline: Foundation Health eyes Physicians Health bid.

text.p: Foundation Health Systems Inc said it was engaged in discussions with Physicians Health Services Inc regarding its possible acquisition of Physicians Health.
Foundation Health said terms of the proposed transaction were still being negotiated but both companies agreed that the final price should not be more than $30 per share.
A number of outstanding issues still needed to be resolved and there could be no assurances discussions would result in a takeover, Foundation Health said.
There would be no further announcements until a pact was reached or talks were terminated, it added.
Physicians Health is the parent of three health maintenance organizations in Connecticut, New York and New Jersey. Foundation Health provides managed healthcare services.
